name: RelayVSR — video upscale 2x
title: Enlarge a video twice, in one pass
summary: Give it a video clip and get it back twice as wide and twice as tall, sharper, in one fast pass; the sound and the frame rate are kept. Not for square videos yet.
description: Upscale a video exactly 2x with RelayVSR, built into ComfyUI since 0.45. A large Wan-based model paints reference latents for keyframes (one every 15 frames) in one sampling step, and a light "Flash" decoder carries them across every frame, so a clip is restored in one streaming pass. This is the 2x pair retrained by LightX2V for the step after H3 generation; the factor comes from the weights, not from a setting. On a 4-second 864x480 clip made by the H3 turbo card it returned 1728x960 in about 18 seconds, all 96 frames at 24 fps with the sound, using about 5 GB of graphics memory: denim seams, hair and the faces in the background came out clearly sharper than a plain enlargement. Only the part of the clip between "Start at" and "Length" is upscaled (5 seconds at most), so a long upload cannot exhaust the card. "Detail kept" sets how much of the detail the decoder adds over a plain bicubic enlargement is kept (1 = all of it). ⚠ A SQUARE video fails on this machine: a bug in the plain-PyTorch fallback of comfy-kitchen, which this rig uses because its PyTorch is older than CUDA 13 (found 2026-11-12). Crop it to 16:9 or 9:16 first. Experimental.
